overview.description: Dwarka, in Saurashtra, Gujarat, is one of India’s favourite spiritual town. Visitors come for its char dham, krishna, coast, with the best months being Oct – Mar.

faq.q: What is the best time to visit Dwarka?
faq.a: The best time to visit Dwarka is Oct – Mar. Summers are 28–36°C and winters are 14–28°C.

The nearest airport is Dwarka / nearest airport (30 km) and the nearest railway station is Rajkot Junction (187 km). Roads are generally good; check seasonal/monsoon conditions before high-altitude or remote stretches.

faq.q: How many days are enough for Dwarka?
faq.a: 2 days are usually enough to cover the top attractions of Dwarka at a relaxed pace.

faq.q: How much does a hotel cost in Dwarka?
faq.a: Stays in Dwarka start from ₹900 per night, with options across 4 price categories.

faq.q: What are the top places to visit in Dwarka?
